title: Bloch Shield DLP third-party sharing policy
description: Org-authored, fail-closed description of which CORPORATE data classes may be shared with which third-party destinations. Evaluated by classification.mjs mayShareWithThirdParty(). Not legal advice; adherence-by-design, not certified.

class.description: The corporate class this grant unblocks. 'restricted' is un-grantable and ignored.

verdict.description: The verdict this grant asserts. A grant may only make a flow MORE permissive; it can never assert 'block'.

expires.description: REQUIRED future RFC-3339 instant. An expired, absent, or unparseable expiry is fail-closed (treated as never given).

revoked.description: A revoked grant is treated as never given.

dpa.description: Is a data-processing agreement on file? Required on file for any 'confidential' grant.
